name: Perimeter Institute International Summer School for Young Physicists (ISSYP)
details: Status check: Perimeter Institute says ISSYP no longer operates. Historically it was a two-week physics enrichment program for Canadian and international high-school students, covering modern physics with lectures, hands-on activities and mentoring. This is a discontinued opportunity; monitor Perimeter for any replacement outreach programs. https://perimeterinstitute.ca/news/25-years-educational-outreach
venue: Perimeter Institute, Waterloo, Ontario, Canada (historical; later editions were online)

name: CERN High-School Students Internship Programme
details: Status check: CERN does not currently advertise a general high-school internship programme. Secondary students may be considered for limited job-shadowing placements only when the placement is mandatory for their school programme; there is no central selection or fixed deadline, and travel/accommodation are the family’s responsibility. Official guidance: https://internship-portal.web.cern.ch/
timing: No fixed dates; usually about one week, only by school-required job-shadowing arrangement.

name: Kupcinet-Getz International Summer Program
details: Correction: this is a research program for bachelor’s/master’s students (or recent bachelor’s graduates), not high-school students. It offers hands-on lab research at the Weizmann Institute in science, mathematics and computer science. The 2026 session ran June 17–August 13. Verify eligibility and dates for the next cycle. https://info.weizmann.ac.il/en/kupcinet-getz-international/
venue: Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel
timing: Summer 2027; dates and application details TBA.

name: NYU ARISE (Applied Research Innovations in Science and Engineering)
details: A free, 10-week NYU Tandon summer program combining research preparation with lab placements. The 2026 program accepted rising juniors and seniors who were full-time NYC residents attending NYC schools; participants could earn a $2,000 stipend. Eligibility and funding may change by year. Official page: https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/arise
venue: NYU Tandon School of Engineering, Brooklyn, New York City, USA
timing: Summer 2027; dates and application timeline TBA.

name: Anson L. Clark Scholars Program (Texas Tech)
details: A highly selective, seven-week faculty-mentored research program for 12 rising high-school seniors and recent graduates. 2026 eligibility required age 17 by program start and U.S. citizenship or permanent residency; participants received room, board and activities, with a $750 stipend after completing the research report. Confirm 2027 eligibility and benefit details with the official site. https://www.depts.ttu.edu/clarkscholars/
venue: Texas Tech University, Lubbock, Texas, USA
timing: Summer 2027; exact dates and application details TBA.

name: Science Internship Program (SIP, UC Santa Cruz)
details: UCSC’s Science Internship Program places high-school students in mentored, open-ended projects across science, engineering, social science, humanities and art. The 2026 format was one online research week followed by seven weeks of in-person work. Check the official page for current eligibility, project availability and fees. https://sip.ucsc.edu/
venue: University of California, Santa Cruz, California, USA
timing: Summer 2027; dates and application details TBA.

name: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research Program (SIMR)
details: A summer research program at Stanford Medicine where high-school students join a biomedical research group, learn research methods and present their work. The 2026 information lists an eight-week program and eligibility details in its official program guide; check the current application for residency, age and grade requirements, which can vary by year. Official program: https://simr.stanford.edu/
venue: Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, California, USA
timing: Summer 2027; dates and application timeline not yet announced.

name: SSRP at Rockefeller University
details: Rockefeller University’s Summer Science Research Program (SSRP) is a seven-week, team-based research experience for high-school students. Participants work with scientists on a research question, learn lab methods, analyze results and present a poster at the program symposium. Eligibility: rising high-school juniors or seniors and at least 16 at program start. The 2027 application and recommendation deadline is January 4, 2027; interviews are expected in March. Official information: https://www.rockefeller.edu/outreach/ssrp/
venue: The Rockefeller University, New York City, USA
timing: Summer 2027; seven weeks (exact dates to be announced). Application deadline: January 4, 2027.
